reports.title: Match Group Announces Third Quarter Results

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: We expect Q4 Total Revenue for Match Group of $865 million to $875 million, down 1% to flat Y/Y.
This range assumes a one-point headwind from FX6. FXN, we expect Total Revenue to be flat to up
1% Y/Y. We expect Indirect Revenue to be approximately $16 million in the quarter.
We expect Match Group Adjusted EBITDA of $327.5 million to $332.5 million, representing an 11% Y/
Y decrease and an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 38% at the mid-points of the ranges. The Y/Y decline
in Adjusted EBITDA is largely due to increased marketing spend at Tinder and Hinge and a gain on
sale related to an LA office building in the prior year quarter.

Total Revenue | Adjusted EBITDA
Q4 2026 | $865 to $875 million | $327.5 to $332.5 million
At the mid-point of our Q4 revenue guidance, we expect Match Group full-year 2026 Total Revenue to
be flat Y/Y, and slightly above the mid-point of the guidance range we provided in February on both an
as reported and FXN basis, with better-than-expected performance at Tinder offsetting the reduction
